name: substack-article-mcp
description: Access Substack articles, comments, feed, and subscriptions — including paid/premium content with optional authentication.
long_description:
Read articles from any Substack newsletter directly from Claude. Public articles work without authentication. Log in to also access paywalled posts, your subscriptions, reader feed, and inbox.

**Authentication is optional.** Public tools (list_articles, get_article, search_articles, get_comments) work without a cookie. To access paid content, subscriptions, and your feed, paste your Substack cookie below.

**How to get your cookie:**
1. Open substack.com in Chrome and log in
2. DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → substack.com
3. Copy the value of 'substack.sid' (and optionally 'substack.lli' for paid articles)
4. Paste as: substack.sid=YOUR_VALUE; substack.lli=YOUR_LLI_VALUE

**Tools included:**
- **list_articles** — Browse recent articles from any newsletter
- **get_article** — Full article content by slug or numeric ID
- **get_comments** — Complete comment tree with replies and reactions
- **search_articles** — Search by keyword across any publication
- **list_subscriptions** — See all newsletters you subscribe to (requires auth)
- **get_feed** — Your personalized reader feed (requires auth)
- **get_inbox** — Chronological inbox from all subscriptions (requires auth)
